outcomes.statement: explains relationships between sustainability, design and production
describes the practices and processes of designers and producers
explains how materials, systems and components contribute to solutions
applies processes in the planning, management and production of projects
communicates and evaluates design ideas and solutions
selects and safely uses tools, materials, technologies and processes
demonstrates technological literacy to safely interact in digital environments
uses data and digital systems to code, design and produce projects

periods.student_work: Teach Design situation and brief and Users and needs. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks, two guided responses and initial design notes
syllabus_content: Food-practice design factors

periods.student_work: Teach Criteria and constraints. Complete its check and response; model a brief; finish Brief and criteria studio.
periods.evidence: Check the completed knowledge check, approved brief and workable criteria
syllabus_content: Critical and creative thinking for quality solutions

periods.student_work: Teach Personal hygiene and Cross-contamination. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks, hygiene routine and cross-contamination controls
syllabus_content: Safe use of tools, technologies and processes

periods.student_work: Teach Hazards and controls; complete its check and response. Run an approved safety demonstration or practical.
periods.evidence: Check the hazard response and readiness; observe safe setup and tool use
syllabus_content: Practical skills with equipment, tools and processes

periods.student_work: Finish Brief and criteria studio or Safety scenario lab. Check folio, saved evidence and practical readiness; catch up unfinished work.
periods.evidence: Check the folio is set up and challenge and safety evidence is complete
syllabus_content: Documenting food-project design processes

periods.focus: Tools, workflow and mise en place
periods.student_work: Teach Mise en place and Selecting tools. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks, justified tool choices and organised setup
syllabus_content: Selecting and justifying tools, techniques and processes

periods.student_work: Teach A clean workflow; complete its check and response. Run an approved tools and workflow practical.
periods.evidence: Check the workflow response; observe safe sequencing and clean-down
syllabus_content: Safe practical use of tools and processes

periods.student_work: Teach A layered food system and Sensory properties. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks, labelled layer roles and sensory profile
syllabus_content: Food characteristics and properties

periods.student_work: Teach Function and stability; complete its check and response. Run an approved analysis or sensory practical.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check, sensory profile and stability explanation
syllabus_content: Ingredient selection and preparation for nutrition

periods.student_work: Complete Burger deconstruction lab. Use learning about layers, sensory properties, function and stability to justify the plan.
periods.evidence: Check a labelled layer plan with reasons for the chosen order
syllabus_content: Design factors used to evaluate food solutions

periods.student_work: Teach From primary production to plate and Local and seasonal choices. Complete both checks and responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks and an accurately traced ingredient journey
syllabus_content: Food production, harvesting, packaging and distribution

periods.student_work: Teach Ethical and environmental factors; complete its check and response. Research origins and finish Ingredient journey investigation.
periods.evidence: Check the completed knowledge check and ingredient journey with source links
syllabus_content: Production and distribution technologies

periods.student_work: Teach Divergent thinking and Annotating concepts. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks and clearly annotated design concepts
syllabus_content: Critical and creative thinking for quality solutions

periods.student_work: Teach Choosing with evidence; complete its check and response. Create four concepts and justify one in Four-concept design studio.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check, four distinct concepts and reasoned selection
syllabus_content: Documenting and communicating design processes

periods.student_work: Run a teacher-approved component or recipe trial; record observations and changes against the selected criteria.
periods.evidence: Check the trial record, observations and reasons for each change
syllabus_content: Food-preparation techniques and production skills

periods.student_work: Teach What plants need and Growing and harvesting herbs. Complete both knowledge checks and guided responses.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks and plant and herb explanations
syllabus_content: Community food initiatives and sustainable resources

periods.student_work: Teach Sustainability in practice; complete its check and response. Complete the approved garden task or teacher-supplied alternative.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check and an observation linking action with effect
syllabus_content: Agricultural practices, quality and waste reduction

periods.student_work: Teach A production-ready recipe and Food order and resources. Complete both checks and responses, then use Production planner.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks, final recipe and complete food order
syllabus_content: Documenting food-production design processes

periods.student_work: Teach Workplan; complete its check and response. Add timing, tools, resources and quality checks to Production planner; obtain approval.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check and teacher-approved production plan
syllabus_content: Justifying equipment, tools and processes

periods.student_work: Run an approved rehearsal or trial; monitor timing and quality, then update the recipe, food order and workplan.
periods.evidence: Check the revised recipe, resource list and workplan after the trial
syllabus_content: Testing, modifying and improving food products

periods.student_work: Teach Follow, monitor, adapt; complete its check and response. Check recipe, roles, resources and safety; start Production evidence log.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check and readiness approval before production
syllabus_content: Production planning and safe processes

periods.student_work: Teach Quality control; complete its check and response. Begin production using the approved recipe and workplan.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check; observe safe process, timing and quality control
syllabus_content: Practical skills with equipment, tools and techniques

periods.student_work: Teach Presentation and evidence; complete its check and response. Finish, present, photograph and clean down; pair with Period 22 if approved.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check, finished burger, photographs and clean-down
syllabus_content: Testing, improving and evaluating the food product

periods.student_work: Teach Evaluate against criteria and Consider the whole solution. Complete both checks and responses; start Evaluation builder.
periods.evidence: Check two knowledge checks and evaluation against the stated criteria
syllabus_content: Design factors used to evaluate solution quality

periods.student_work: Teach Reflect and improve; complete its check and response. Finish Evaluation builder, audit evidence, back up and submit as directed.
periods.evidence: Check the knowledge check, complete backed-up folio and specific improvements
syllabus_content: Written documentation of food-production processes
